_schema: Converted from Sources/TeXCore/Catalog/ (CompletionCatalog.swift, CatalogCommands.swift, CatalogEnvironments.swift, CatalogPackages.swift). Each item mirrors the Swift struct CompletionItem (Sources/TeXCore/Models/Completion.swift) field for field, with camelCase keys: kind (CompletionItem.Kind raw value: command | environment | label | citation | file | package | snippet), label (string), insertText (string, never null; defaults to label when the source field is empty), detail (string or null), package (string or null, the providing package such as amsmath). The computed Swift property id ("<kind>:<label>") is not stored. Top-level arrays: commands (text-mode and general commands, kind command); mathCommands (math-mode commands, kind command); environments (kind environment, where insertText is the expanded text inserted after \begin{: name + "}" + argumentsSnippet + newline + bodySnippet with every line prefixed by a tab + newline + "\end{name}"; body defaults to "$0"); packages (kind package, insertText equals label). The derived Swift list CompletionCatalog.allCommands (commands followed by mathCommands, de-duplicated by label) is not stored. Source table rows are: commands and mathCommands label¦insertSnippet¦detail¦package; environments name¦argumentsSnippet¦bodySnippet¦detail¦package; packages name¦detail; lines starting with # and blank lines are comments. Snippet syntax in insertText: ${n:default} and $n are tab stops, $0 is the final cursor, a real newline is an auto-indented line break, and a real tab is one indent level. Backslashes are literal LaTeX, never escapes.
